Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MS.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 985 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 20% to 7% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2019.
We delivered record revenue of $47.5 billion this quarter, representing 20% year-over-year growth.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $4.8 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 85 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
